name: Mepper Mania
storyline: AstroAxol's meppers, the mischievous band of axolotls, have taken one of her rockets for a joyride and have gotten lost across the solar system. AstroAxol must find and save them all, and she may meet a crazy raccoon along the way.
summary: A game based on the Twitch streamer AstroAxol. This is an early 1980s arcade-style platformer with roguelike elements, featuring several stages across the galaxy.
